ios.desc:
Stop wasting food. Know exactly what you have at home.

iPantry helps you track your food, manage expiration dates, and organize your pantry in seconds. No more forgotten items, expired food, or duplicate shopping.

Organize your pantry with smart tools:
- Create multiple pantries (kitchen, fridge, freezer, garage)
- Add items with quantity, unit, location, and notes
- Track expiration dates and get notified before they expire
- Customize units and organize everything your way

Shop smarter and save money:
- Instantly mark items to buy
- Get alerts for low stock or expiring products
- Export or share your shopping list easily
- Sync with Apple Reminders and collaborate with family

Private and secure with iCloud:
- Your data stays in your iCloud account
- No sign-up, no tracking, no third-party services
- Seamless sync across all your devices

Fast, simple, and built for everyday use:
- Clean interface optimized for iPhone and iPad
- Dark Mode and multi-language support

Upgrade to iPantry Pro:
- Unlimited pantries and items
- Unlimited exports
- No ads

iPantry Pro is available as a subscription with automatic renewal. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your App Store account settings.
Download iPantry today to organize smarter, save time, and reduce food waste.
If you enjoy using iPantry, please consider leaving a review on the App Store. Your feedback means a lot and helps us make the app even better. Thank you!

- If you have a question or need immediate support, please send an email to support@8mobile.org.

*** Info ***
- To manage and display the iPantry list in the Reminders app, make sure the following setting is enabled: Settings > Privacy > Reminders
- To use iCloud sync, you must be signed in with your Apple ID and iCloud must be enabled on your device.
- iPantry Pro will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal will be charged at the same price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

show_hn.title: Show HN: iPantry – Track food inventory and reduce waste

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

iPantry is a simple app I built to solve a recurring problem in my home: forgetting what we already had in the pantry or fridge, buying duplicates, and letting food expire.

With a busy schedule and a shared household, it became easy to lose track of what was available, especially when grocery shopping was split among family members. We'd end up with multiple milk cartons or expired pasta tucked away in the back of the cupboard.

I couldn’t find an app that was both easy to use and shareable with native iOS tools. Most were either too complex or locked features behind account systems or external sync.

So I made iPantry:
- Track products with quantities and expiration dates
- Get low stock and expiry alerts
- Export lists or share items via iCloud and Apple Reminders
- All data stays in your iCloud account, synced across devices
- No registration or third-party service required

It’s a small tool built for clarity and speed. I'd love to hear your thoughts, ideas, or critique. 
Thanks for taking a look.
